headline: Groups per candidate improved roughly ninefold against R11. The extrapolated yield from the Europe PMC portion of the capture alone lands inside the range the power analysis requires.

measurement.design: Restricted to EUROPE_PMC-sourced candidates so retrieval-coverage loss and extraction conversion loss are measured separately rather than conflated. Uniform random sample, seed 20260908.

comparison_to_history.caveat: R11 counted groups under a different and also defective definition. The comparison indicates direction, not a like-for-like ratio.

against_the_power_requirement.requirement: Detecting the observed effect size of about 0.03 NDCG at 80% power needs roughly 350-800 groups, per the earlier estimate at SD 0.2-0.3.
against_the_power_requirement.assessment: For the first time in this project the measured trajectory reaches the statistical threshold rather than falling two orders of magnitude short.
against_the_power_requirement.not_established: This is supervision-capable volume, not admitted supervision.

OPERATOR_ERROR_CORRECTED.error: The operator presented 350-800 groups as the threshold that matters, and let it be read as an ANFIS training threshold. It is not.
OPERATOR_ERROR_CORRECTED.what_350_800_actually_is: An EVALUATION power figure: the sample needed to detect an observed effect of about 0.03 NDCG at 80% power in a paired comparison of two ranking systems. It answers whether A beats B, not whether a model can be fitted.

what_anfis_actually_needs.reason: ANFIS fits membership-function premise parameters and rule consequent parameters. Rule count grows as m^n for n inputs with m membership functions each, and every rule carries its own consequent parameters.
what_anfis_actually_needs.illustration: A conservative 4 inputs x 3 membership functions is already 81 rules; with consequent parameters per rule the parameter count reaches the hundreds. At a common 5-10 samples per parameter this implies thousands of samples.
what_anfis_actually_needs.owner_position: Even 250 as a floor is not safe. Recorded as correct.
what_anfis_actually_needs.status: The specific requirement depends on the chosen architecture and has NOT been computed. No ANFIS architecture has been specified.

OPERATOR_ERROR_CORRECTED.revised_reading_of_the_265_789_range: Adequate for EVALUATION. Not established as adequate for ANFIS training, and on the owner's assessment almost certainly not.
OPERATOR_ERROR_CORRECTED.consequence: The gap between evaluation-adequate and training-adequate volume is now the open question, and it is larger than any figure this project has previously targeted.

what_a_group_is_here.definition: A distinct (DOI, surviving sample label) pair on a table that passed the repaired gates and carried at least two resolvable descriptor concepts.
what_a_group_is_here.is_not: An admitted assertion. Evidence-trace, rights and governed-mapping admission still apply downstream and were not run.
what_a_group_is_here.known_downstream_loss: R9 measured only 152 of 632 named outputs carrying a direct evidence trace, 24.05%, rising to 31.93% after abstention. That loss has not been re-measured post-repair and is not reflected in these figures.

the_three_separated_losses.measured: 83% of a mixed-source sample had no open Europe PMC full-text route
the_three_separated_losses.note: OpenAlex indexes far more publishers than PMC holds.

the_three_separated_losses.measured: 10.1% of the capture qualified only through an abstract mention; in the mixed sample these surfaced as epidemiology tables such as chi-square tests, evaluator demographics and adjusted odds ratios for metabolic syndrome
the_three_separated_losses.note: The repaired gates rejected these correctly. The defect is upstream.

the_three_separated_losses.measured: 4.0% of candidates yield groups; 0.377 groups per candidate
the_three_separated_losses.note: This is the number four rounds never isolated.

inherited_defect_found_and_fixed.defect: R10 built Europe PMC full-text URLs as {BASE}/PMC/{pmcid}/fullTextXML. pmcid already carries the PMC prefix, so every stored URL returns 404.
inherited_defect_found_and_fixed.propagation: acquire_round2_capture.py copied the R10 pattern; 1218 captured URLs were malformed.
inherited_defect_found_and_fixed.status: FIXED in both scripts and repaired in place in the capture manifest.
inherited_defect_found_and_fixed.operator_note: This is the second R10 defect the operator reproduced by following existing code without verifying it. The first was estimating capture headroom from hit counts without measuring licence-resolution rates.

RETRACTION.withdrawn_claim: Groups per candidate improved roughly ninefold against R11, extrapolating to 265-789 groups from the Europe PMC portion.
RETRACTION.status: WITHDRAWN — the headline counted groups without auditing what they were made of.

RETRACTION.consequence_for_the_power_claim: The earlier statement that the measured trajectory reaches the evaluation threshold for the first time is withdrawn. Roughly 89 on-subject groups over the Europe PMC portion is below the evaluation range, and far below any ANFIS training requirement, which the owner correctly notes is not safe even at 250.

operator_process_defect.pattern: Three errors of the same class in this session, all reporting a number without first verifying its composition.
instances: Rated 15000-20000 capture as plausible from hit counts without measuring licence-resolution rates.
Copied R10's malformed Europe PMC URL construction without verifying it returned content.
Reported 113 groups as a ninefold improvement without auditing whether the groups came from coffee sensory papers.
operator_process_defect.self_assessment: This is the exact failure mode recorded as R12C-F7 and criticised in R11: counting extraction volume as if it were admitted material. Verification has been happening after reporting rather than before it.
operator_process_defect.corrective_rule_proposed: No count is reported until its composition has been audited. For group counts specifically: subject verdict and named-versus-dimension evidence split must accompany any headline figure.

evidence_type_finding.finding: Even among on-subject groups the evidence is heavily dimension-level rather than named-descriptor.
evidence_type_finding.significance: The product task is named descriptors. Dimension-level supervision is a different type and does not serve it directly. This mirrors the T4-versus-T1 asymmetry R11 found and reinforces that the abundant material is dimensions, not names.
